GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 1kg over allotted weight. Shortly after jumping was bumped and, as a result, made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, same turn, Straightened Up 5l off, found little, dropped out # keen/poor?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced keenly during the early stages. Near the 400m was momentarily steadied off heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, hit line well without threatening # back/home ok

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began well sat 2nd outside leader 3len pulled midrace took sit 4th 3len 400m took run home ok honest effort # ready

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Rounding the home turn was steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 600m & Five Wide @ 500m. Chasing Seven Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & laid in @ 150m. Unable to be fully ridden out late. # Wide/held ground.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, was steadied when buffeted between runners. Near the 50m was steadied when hampered by another runner which was carried out. As a result, went to the line without being fully tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair makes grd fence then eases 5l Just Off Mid-Field home turn 4l angles Middle Of Track Straightening Up finishing on well but 100m Eased of heels. Limited luck early and finish. Went well # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m improved onto the heels of another runner and had to be steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, Made Some Ground to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and mate late ground down the outside in Straight # Did Best Work Late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the start was bumped out across heels.
